desc:
🎓 Welcome to Magnolia State University! 🌸

Based on college life down South. Live the full experience, from your first day as a freshman to walking the stage at graduation.

📚 STUDY: Enroll, choose your major and attend real class sessions on the campus clock. Keep your GPA up and earn credits to move from Freshman to Senior.

🏠 LIVE: Claim a dorm room or lease an apartment. Decorate with beds, desks, gaming setups, TVs and LED lights.

💼 WORK: Pick up shifts on campus and in College Town to earn cash.

💜 JOIN: Complete intake to cross into a Greek organization, rep your letters and move into your chapter house.

📱 Your student phone has it all: classes, grades, bank, jobs, housing and The Yard, where you post, follow friends and host parties.

🎉 GRADUATE: Cross the stage at Magnolia Stadium during Saturday Commencement to get your diploma!

Explore the Yard, the Quad, Greek Row and College Town, make friends and build your college story. 💛
